quarterly_data.quarter: GlobalFoundries IR presentation: Advancing Semiconductor Leadership in America Presentation (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Malta model and timeline (investor webinar): a special purpose vehicle owned by the U.S. and Japanese governments funds and owns the fab infrastructure, tooling and operating expenses and receives the wafer revenue; GF builds and operates the fabs, provides its technology (including FDX, UX and BCD) and manages operating expenses, and earns technology, construction and operating management fees plus EBITDA sharing and shared-services reimbursement (technology fees commence in 2027 and run for a minimum of 20 years). Phase 1 and Phase 2 together are up to ~1.8M wafers/yr (300mm-equivalent, ~900k per phase at full run rate; the Phase 2 fab is subject to approval), with 1,000+ high-skilled manufacturing jobs. On GF's illustrative timeline Phase 1 is ready for equipment in 2028, has its first wafer out in 2029 and reaches baseline capacity in 2031, and Phase 2 has its first wafer out in 2031 (page 9 chart). Renesas CEO Hidetoshi Shibata is quoted in the deck: 'We are planning around GF's new capacity in New York as an extension of Renesas‘ own production footprint'.
quarterly_data.figure: up to ~1.8M wafers/yr for Phase 1 + 2; Phase 1 first wafer out 2029 (page 9 chart)
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (planning around the new Malta capacity)
